mapper.insert: insert into xl_idle_item (user_id, title, category, description, price_stars, images, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{description}, #{priceStars}, #{images}, '0', now(), now())
mapper.update: update xl_idle_item set title=#{title}, category=#{category}, description=#{description}, price_stars=#{priceStars}, images=#{images}, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
update xl_idle_item set status=#{status}, buyer_id=#{buyerId}, update_time=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.delete: delete from xl_idle_item where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and status='0'
mapper.select: select id, user_id, title, category, description, price_stars, images, status, buyer_id, create_time, update_time from xl_idle_item where id=#{id}
select id, user_id, title, category, description, price_stars, images, status, buyer_id, create_time, update_time from xl_idle_item where user_id=#{userId} order by create_time desc
